---
title: "Movimientos"
---

```{=html}

<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div>
    <h1>Movimientos</h1>
    <div class="tf-muted">Registro rápido para lo esencial; factura, referencia y divisiones quedan en detalles opcionales.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button>
</div>

<div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2 tf-transactions-layout">
  <section class="tf-card tf-tx-editor-card">
    <div class="tf-section-heading">
      <div>
        <div class="tf-section-kicker">Registro rápido</div>
        <h2 id="tx-editor-title">Nuevo movimiento</h2>
      </div>
    </div>

    <form id="tx-form" class="tf-tx-quick-form">
      <select id="tx-type" hidden aria-hidden="true">
        <option value="expense">Egreso</option>
        <option value="income">Ingreso</option>
        <option value="transfer">Transferencia</option>
      </select>

      <div class="tf-tx-type-switch" role="group" aria-label="Tipo de movimiento">
        <button type="button" class="tf-tx-type-btn" data-tx-type="expense">Gasto</button>
        <button type="button" class="tf-tx-type-btn" data-tx-type="income">Ingreso</button>
        <button type="button" class="tf-tx-type-btn" data-tx-type="transfer">Transferencia</button>
      </div>

      <div class="tf-tx-amount-block">
        <label for="tx-amount">Monto</label>
        <div class="tf-tx-amount-input-wrap">
          <span>$</span>
          <input id="tx-amount" type="text" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="0,00" autocomplete="off" required>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="single-account-fields" class="tf-field">
        <label>Cuenta</label>
        <select id="tx-account"></select>
      </div>

      <div id="transfer-fields" class="tf-form-grid" hidden>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Desde</label><select id="tx-from"></select></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Hacia</label><select id="tx-to"></select></div>
      </div>

      <div id="category-fields" class="tf-field">
        <label>Categoría y subcategoría</label>
        <button id="tx-category-picker" type="button" class="tf-tx-category-picker">Seleccionar categoría y subcategoría</button>
        <select id="tx-category" hidden aria-hidden="true"></select>
        <select id="tx-subcategory" hidden aria-hidden="true"></select>
      </div>

      <div class="tf-field">
        <label>Descripción</label>
        <input id="tx-description" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Ej. Almuerzo, combustible, sueldo…">
      </div>

      <div class="tf-form-grid">
        <div class="tf-field">
          <label>Fecha</label>
          <input id="tx-date" type="date" required>
        </div>
        <div class="tf-field">
          <label>Hora</label>
          <input id="tx-time" type="time" required>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tf-tx-date-shortcuts">
          <button type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" data-date-shortcut="today">Hoy</button>
          <button type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" data-date-shortcut="yesterday">Ayer</button>
      </div>

      <details id="tx-more-details" class="tf-tx-more-details">
        <summary>Más detalles <span>Factura, referencia y divisiones</span></summary>
        <div class="tf-tx-details-body">
          <div class="tf-field"><label>Comprobante / referencia</label><input id="tx-receipt" autocomplete="off"></div>

          <div id="invoice-toggle-wrap" class="tf-check" hidden>
            <input id="tx-has-invoice" type="checkbox">
            <label>Ingreso con factura e IVA</label>
          </div>

          <div id="invoice-panel" class="tf-subtle" hidden>
            <div class="tf-form-grid">
              <div class="tf-field"><label>Número de factura</label><input id="tx-invoice-number" autocomplete="off"></div>
              <div class="tf-field"><label>IVA incluido en el total ($)</label><input id="tx-vat" type="text" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="0,00" autocomplete="off"></div>
            </div>
            <div id="tx-invoice-summary" class="tf-muted" style="margin-top:.55rem">Base sin IVA: $0,00</div>
            <div id="tx-invoice-lock" class="tf-alert tf-alert-info" style="margin-top:.55rem"></div>
          </div>

          <div id="transfer-charge-panel" class="tf-subtle" hidden>
            <strong>Cargos e impuestos de la operación</strong>
            <div class="tf-form-grid" style="margin-top:.65rem">
              <div class="tf-field"><label>Comisión bancaria ($)</label><input id="tx-fee" type="text" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="0,00"></div>
              <div class="tf-field"><label>Impuestos ($)</label><input id="tx-tax" type="text" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="0,00"></div>
              <div class="tf-field"><label>Otros cargos ($)</label><input id="tx-other-charge" type="text" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="0,00"></div>
            </div>
            <div id="tx-gross-debit" class="tf-alert tf-alert-info" style="margin-top:.55rem">Total que saldrá: $0,00</div>
          </div>

          <div id="split-toggle-wrap" class="tf-check">
            <input id="tx-split-enabled" type="checkbox">
            <label>Dividir el movimiento entre varias categorías</label>
          </div>
          <div id="split-panel" class="tf-subtle" hidden>
            <div id="split-rows"></div>
            <div class="tf-actions">
              <button id="add-split" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Añadir división</button>
              <span id="split-total" class="tf-muted"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </details>

      <div class="tf-tx-save-bar">
        <button id="tx-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Cancelar edición</button>
        <button id="tx-submit" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="submit">Guardar movimiento</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </section>

  <section class="tf-card tf-tx-filter-card">
    <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Historial</div><h2>Buscar y organizar</h2></div></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Buscar</label><input id="filter-search" placeholder="Descripción, categoría, cuenta…"></div>
    <div class="tf-form-grid">
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="filter-type"><option value="all">Todos</option><option value="expense">Gastos</option><option value="income">Ingresos</option><option value="transfer">Transferencias</option></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta</label><select id="filter-account"></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Período</label><select id="filter-period"><option value="all">Todo</option><option value="month" selected>Este mes</option><option value="year">Este año</option></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Ordenar</label><select id="filter-sort"><option value="recent">Más recientes</option><option value="oldest">Más antiguos</option><option value="amount_desc">Mayor monto</option><option value="amount_asc">Menor monto</option><option value="category">Categoría A–Z</option></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Categoría</label><select id="filter-category"><option value="all">Todas</option></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Subcategoría</label><select id="filter-subcategory"><option value="all">Todas</option></select></div>
    </div>
    <button id="filter-clear" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Limpiar filtros</button>
  </section>
</div>

<dialog id="tx-category-dialog" class="tf-tx-category-dialog">
  <div class="tf-tx-category-dialog-head">
    <div>
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Clasificación</div>
      <h3 id="tx-category-dialog-title">Seleccionar categoría</h3>
    </div>
    <button id="tx-category-dialog-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cerrar</button>
  </div>
  <div id="tx-category-dialog-body" class="tf-tx-category-options"></div>
</dialog>


<dialog id="tx-detail-dialog" class="tf-tx-category-dialog">
  <div class="tf-tx-category-dialog-head">
    <div>
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Detalle del movimiento</div>
      <h3 id="tx-detail-title">Movimiento</h3>
      <div id="tx-detail-meta" class="tf-muted"></div>
    </div>
    <button id="tx-detail-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cerrar</button>
  </div>
  <div id="tx-detail-body"></div>
</dialog>

<div class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <div class="tf-table-wrap">
    <table class="tf-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Fecha / hora</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Cuenta</th><th>Categoría</th><th>Detalle</th><th>Monto</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="tx-body"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>

<script type="module" src="js/transactions-v1.js"></script>
```
